text:
Maria: Morning — quick micro-standup for the cutover tomorrow. What I did / blockers / today. I'll start.

Devon: Did: finished the routing-fallback spec and perf test plan. Blocker: still waiting on runtime perf numbers for short sequences. Today: pair with infra to run distributed qps.

Chris: Did: landed CR #412 for the embeddings cache. Blocker: CI flakes on linux-37 causing a couple test failures. Today: triage tests + rebase.

Sam: Did: finalised the canary smoke script. Blocker: missing cert for the private deploy smoke tests. Today: try alt cert / ping infra.

Ellen: Product note: to hit latency SLOs for launch I recommend cutting bulk-export and deferred analytics from v1. Keep core generate/chat/embeddings. Thoughts?

Maria: +1 to a narrower launch scope. We can ship faster and iterate. I'll mark bulk-export as deprioritized in the spec doc.

Chris: @Maria I can add a feature flag for bulk-export in the deployment manifest. Quick plan: add `FEATURE_BULK_EXPORT=false` and keep toggle.

Sam: Quick smoke run output: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
# response 200, p99 ~180ms for 1-token warm path
```

Deploy Bot: Canary deployed to us-west-2 @rev=abc123 :rocket:

Devon: Priority decision needed: routing policy — latency-first for dedicated / SLA customers, cost-first for free tier? I think that's the simplest mapping.

Maria: Vote check: latency-first for Dedicated, cost-first for Hosted free tier.

Ellen: +1 (latency-first for Dedicated, cost-first for hosted free tier).

Chris: Quick ping: @Sam can you review my batching change? Left a couple comments on the PR.

Sam: On it, will take after the cert attempt.

Maria: Blocker recap: runtime perf numbers (Devon) — ETA EOD; certs for private smoke (Sam) — ETA tomorrow AM; CI flaky tests (Chris) — fix PR incoming in ~30m. Owners noted.

Devon: Confirming EOD for perf numbers, will post raw numbers and a short summary here.

Sam: Cert ETA tomorrow 0900 PT, will update the ticket.

Chris: CI fix PR is pushed: #419, will ping reviewers in 5m.

Maria: If anyone objects to cutting bulk-export for launch, say now. Otherwise I'll update the spec and rollout checklist.

Ellen: No objection.

Maria: Filing change now: https://docs.redwood/infraprot/specs/cutover-v1 (internal). Rollout checklist (short):
- confirm perf numbers and p95/p99
- smoke canary + certs green
- feature flag for bulk-export off by default
- finalize routing policy mapping
- legal/data ok for embeddings export (if needed later)

Chris: I'll add the flag and a tiny README for operators.

Sam: After cert is in place I'll run the private smoke and report back.

Maria: Great. Thanks all — keep async updates here. If anything blocks launch timeline, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
